authorization_basis: The active user goal authorizes progressing from the completed single-case minimum test toward a favorable e2e benchmark set. This is a bounded internal decision, not a new user approval.
why: The one native Claude development pair passed both quality gates at8/10 with lower reported input and lower native/outer slot wall. Two fresh pairs test whether the reported-input signal repeats before expanding this native stack to more issues. Prior custom Claude/OpenCode confirmation failures remain unchanged.
configuration: Reuse the original native q001 question, rubric, frozen full source, agent/model/endpoint, Rust binary, embeddings, guidance, limits, no-web/source-only scope and grading contract exactly. No shared index or native installation volumes. No prompt or task changes.
execution: One workflow dispatch, attempt1, two matrix jobs with fail-fast:false and max-parallel:1 on distinct fresh GitHub runners. c01 baseline then zg; c02 zg then baseline. Matrix serialism does not assert an overall c01-before-c02 order. Each scheduled profile at most once.
identity: New confirmation protocol and plan SHA in execution/collection. Exclusive sibling context records pair/order/base-plan and development-summary hashes before execution. Associate records by pair and profile, then native trial/session identities and answer SHA, never array position.

primary_confirmation.name: reported-input signal repeated in both confirmation pairs
each_pair_conditions: Both executions valid after independent source-only/tool audit.
Both pass unchanged original quality gate: >=8/10, full C1-C3, valid actual core citations, no critical contradiction.
zg factual score is at least baseline score.
Both sole expected-model CLI modelUsage totals are available with all four finite nonnegative fields and no contradiction to complete persisted evidence.
zg reported input (uncached+cache read+cache creation) is strictly below baseline.
At least one actual successful, correct-/workspace, materially relevant zg retrieval.
primary_confirmation.rule: All conditions must hold separately in both planned pairs. No pooling the development pair, no dropping a failed/incomplete pair, no cross-pair averaging to override a failed pair.

secondary_reporting.quality_candidate: Apply the original independent quality-candidate definition to each pair: execution-valid zg passes and baseline fails, zg score>=baseline, relevant successful retrieval. Report separately even when primary efficiency confirmation fails.
secondary_reporting.time: Report native execution, setup/index, audit/export, Harbor intervals, outer slot and collection separately. Only if both outer slots decrease may the report state repeated observed outer-slot time reduction. Outer slots exclude CI queue, common preparation and later collection; no whole-workflow/billing claim.
secondary_reporting.c6: Keep original prospective primary error-handling criterion; report the predeclared lifecycle-only sensitivity separately without substituting it.
secondary_reporting.accounting: Keep reported and strict persisted scopes separate with actual corroboration status. Missing fields never filled, no root-only fallback, no child-metadata addition. Embedding costs/provider billing remain unknown.

grading: Fresh blinded source-grounded reviewer sees randomized exact-byte final answers, original task/rubric/contract and frozen source only; no pair/condition/resource/trajectory/history. Verify quote attribution and distinguish auditor-added spans from actual answer citations.
stopping: Stop after the two planned pairs and independent audits. Retain every failure or partial result. No retries, replacements or post-outcome task/prompt/grading changes. If confirmation fails, do not keep sampling this signal until it passes. Any materially different hypothesis or new-task expansion requires its own prospective decision.
limits: Two confirmation pairs concern one previously observed task; even successful repetition does not establish a representative favorable benchmark set, immutable model weights, contamination freedom, independent provider billing or general causal benefit.
ci: Only Cuiyus/zvec-grep; upstream reads are source and existing Rust artifact only.
